newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Capral says 1st qtr similar to last year.
newsitem.headline: Capral says 1st qtr similar to last year.

text.p: Capral Aluminium Ltd said on Tuesday the 1997 first quarter performance was similar to the first quarter of 1996.
"It's in the same ballpark," Capral chairman Jeremy Davis told reporters after the annual general meeting.
Davis said the upstream business was performing reasonable well with metal prices similar or slightly better than last year and metal production also slightly higher.
"The pressures in the downstream business has been quite considerable," he said.
He stated the flatness of the Australian economy and a slower pick-up in the housing sector than the company had expected were reasons for the flat result.
